long_biography.plain_text:
Outsource Partners International turned Kishore Hiranand Mirchandani's accounting expertise into a global outsourcing business. Trained at Deloitte in London, he qualified as a chartered accountant before moving into financial leadership and public accounting in New York. He previously founded a New York accounting firm that was sold in 2002.

At OPI, Mirchandani combined US client development with oversight of a major Indian service centre. The business expanded internationally before its 2011 acquisition, after which he helped integrate its finance-and-accounting operations. He subsequently served as finance chief at a media company and joined boards spanning agriculture and investment management. He serves as a Simply Fresh director and a director of an investment fund.
